async def act(page):
    # Set the 'From' date to 05/01/2022
    from_date = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='From *')
    await from_date.fill('05/01/2022')
    # Set the 'To' date to 05/31/2023
    to_date = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='To *')
    await to_date.fill('05/31/2023')
    # Click the Export button to generate the report
    export_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Export')
    await export_button.click()
    # Wait for the export/download to initiate
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
